findings.reason: The contract exempts signature-verified logout notifications from endpoint rate limiting. Rejected notifications are limited to 120 per minute.
Verifies the signed logout notification and restricts revocation to matched sessions.
Uses the current browser session, checks CSRF, and requires fresh reauthentication for deletion.
Starts browser-bound login without reading or modifying an application record.
Consumes browser-bound state once and verifies ID token claims before binding identity.
Validates the Identity Sync service identity and issuer before provisioning.
Validates the Identity Sync service identity and issuer before membership removal.
Validates the Identity Sync service identity and issuer before anonymization.
Validates the Identity Sync service identity and issuer before identity inventory.
Requires the System Manager role before touching internal session mappings.
Deletes only session mappings selected by the verified logout notification.
System Manager maintenance deletes expired internal session mappings.
Internal callers save only the linked account or the site selected during authorized anonymization.
Authorized anonymization selects files owned by or attached to its linked account.
Authorized anonymization selects SSH keys belonging to its linked account.
Checks that the current non-guest user owns the identity link before writing the session mapping.
Only the verified login callback and authorized service provisioning create identity links.
Verified login and service provisioning create a team under its validated local owner.
Matches the current account and exact logout session ID before deleting the internal mapping.

Guest recovery request is POST-only and rate limited, rejects extra fields and non-text input, gives the same answer for every address and only queues one background job. The request never looks up the account.

The background job runs as Guest, who cannot create records, so it inserts one Open review only for an existing identity link with no open review. The controller freezes the record and a non-owner reviewer decides.
Checks DocType select permission and rejects custom queries on governed types before search.
Checks DocType select permission and rejects custom queries on governed types before search.
Checks DocType select permission and rejects custom queries on governed types before link validation.
Creates the “Tenant Admin” role from ensure_role, an after_install and after_migrate hook that no endpoint whitelists (G-62). The role is made with desk access off.

Saves the Custom DocPerm row after require_manager, a type and role key check and _require_open (G-62). guard_custom_docperm still runs on save and refuses protected roles, standard roles and closed types.

Inserts the Custom DocPerm row after require_manager, a type and role key check and _require_open (G-62). guard_custom_docperm still runs before insert and refuses protected roles, standard roles and closed types.
Deletes the Custom DocPerm row after require_manager, a type and role key check and _require_open (G-62). guard_custom_docperm still runs on trash.

Saves the users of a Role Profile that guard_role_profile allowed to hold only plain roles (G-62). Administrator and users with any role that is not plain are skipped. guard_user still runs on each save.
Lets only a System User or a “Tenant Admin” call it and checks DocType read permission (G-62). explain() refuses another user's explanation unless the caller is a System Manager.
Checks DocType read permission before returning the session user’s access summary.
Delegates to tenant_admin.list_role_permissions, whose first step require_manager refuses everyone but System Manager, Administrator and “Tenant Admin” (G-62).
Delegates to tenant_admin.set_role_permission, whose first step require_manager refuses everyone but System Manager, Administrator and “Tenant Admin” (G-62).
Delegates to tenant_admin.remove_role_permission, whose first step require_manager refuses everyone but System Manager, Administrator and “Tenant Admin” (G-62).

Answers only for the signed-in session user; a guest gets PermissionError. The server reads that user's own records as evidence and ignores body fields such as user. No document is chosen by the caller.
Signed-in session user only; a guest gets PermissionError. The final step reruns the same decision and stays closed until the price decision (G-166). No document is chosen by the caller.
The server opens one owner task per empty rule for the System Manager role (G-167). The text is built from the policy, not from the request. The calling user needs no ToDo write right.

Writes the verification case only from open_attempt, a server-side call that no endpoint whitelists. The case id is checked for length first (G-164). Both DocTypes are closed to AI writes in hooks.py.
Stores the notice only after the HMAC signature over the raw body is verified (G-164). The caller is the provider without a session. The unique event_id index refuses duplicates.

Inserts the internal file job only after require_user, route authorization and a File read check on the chosen PDF (G-156). The caller sets only route, file, instruction and limit. Both DocTypes are closed to AI writes in hooks.py.

Saves the chunk plan from prepare_job, a queue step that no endpoint whitelists (G-156). Page and chunk counts are capped by site settings before any row is written. Chunk text is cleared after each attempt and when the job finishes.
